2026-10-19.title: Start Strong: Find Your First Step
2026-10-19.subtitle: Identify the smallest, immediate physical action to kick off any project, no matter how daunting.
2026-10-19.caption:
Ever feel stuck before a big task? Instead of seeing the whole mountain, just look for the very first pebble: pinpoint the single, physical micro-action needed to simply begin. For example, if 'clean the kitchen' feels huge, your first step might be 'pick up one dirty mug.' This small shift reduces overwhelm, making it easier to start and build momentum. Give it a try!
